messages:
deploy-bot: [NOTICE] deploybot paused: Release candidate 2026.03.15-rc4 -> prod (service:web) scheduled 22:00 UTC held due to incident INC-2026-042 (control-plane allocation failures). Actions: hold deploy slot, pin current prod version, cancel queued slots. @alex @maria

alex: Copy. Getting context — were canaries already started? I thought canary run was 22:00 as well. Need quick decision: rollback previous rollout or keep current prod and reschedule RC?

maria: Canaries didn't start. Control plane still failing to allocate new pods for a subset of regions (us-west-2 first). Ops recommends blocking any new rollouts until control plane stable + one post-incident validation window.

tj: Agree with ops. Recommend pinning prod version everywhere for the next slot. If we allow partial rollouts we risk multi-region divergence. Suggest pin = `service:web@2026.03.10-9f2b` and disable autoscale for the slot.

emily: FYI the RC includes a quantization kernel tweak that can spike tail latency in some workloads — pin + run perf tests before reattempting rollout.

carlos: Customer-facing release notes are mostly infra + perf improvements. If we delay, I'll mark notes as 'scheduled' and remove the publish flag. Who will own the draft updates?

alex: I'll own release notes updates. Proposed immediate steps: 1) pin prod snapshot (maria) 2) cancel queued deploy slots for 22:00 (deploy-bot) 3) schedule new slot after post-incident validation, target Change Window C (02:00-04:00 UTC) 4) only rollback if error budget is breached after attempted rollout.

maria: Starting pin runbook now -> `kubectl annotate svc/web release-pin=2026.03.10-9f2b` (runbook step). Will post output.

deploy-bot: ACK. Hold recorded for slot 2026-03-15T22:00Z. Queued slots cancelled. To unhold: `/deploy unhold <slot-id>` or use the console.

maria: ran: `kubectl annotate svc/web release-pin=2026.03.10-9f2b`
-> annotation added to svc/web
No downtime expected.

tj: After pin, also mark canary flag to skip until incident validation completes. Suggested config update: `rollout: {strategy: canary, canary_enabled: false}`. We'll re-enable only after validation doc passes.

emily: I'll kick off perf + latency baseline against pinned prod (approx 30m). Also queue KV cache warmup: `scripts/warm_kv.sh --duration 5m`.

alex: Proposed reschedule: target 2026-03-16 02:00 UTC (Change Window C). If incident resolves earlier we can consider an opportunistic slot at 23:30 UTC only after 1h of stable metrics.

carlos: I'll update release notes draft and set status to "on-hold" in the docs. Removing preview publish.

alex: Final call for now: NO ROLLBACK. Hold + pin + reschedule. Action owners: maria (pin + confirm), emily (perf tests + warmup), alex (reschedule + release notes), tj (post-incident validation checklist).

maria: pinned ✅. Output: `annotation/service:web release-pin=2026.03.10-9f2b`

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 update: investigator assigned; control-plane controller errors ongoing, error rate elevated. ETA unknown.

tj: If incident still active at 01:00 UTC we'll cancel Change Window C. I'll post a health-check summary at 00:45 UTC.

alex: Copy. Attaching quick rollback decision rubric (summary): if client 5xx rate rises > 0.5% after attempted rollout -> rollback to pinned version. Otherwise prefer hold and retest. I'll paste full rubric into the release repo next.

emily: note: perf + KV warmup queued. Running now. Will report results in ~35m.

carlos: thanks all — unpublishing release note preview now. Will re-open when we have a confirmed slot. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks. Keeping channel updated.

[thread closed for now; reactions: :white_check_mark: from maria, :eyes: from tj]
